matter-codex commands:
`/agents status` - show runtime status
`/agents repo add github owner/name [default-branch]` - add repository metadata and repo-channel
`/agents repo list` - show connected repositories
`/agents github check owner/name` - check GitHub repo access
`/agents github branch dry-run owner/name branch [base]` - validate branch creation without changes
`/agents github branch create owner/name branch [base]` - create branch from base
`/agents github pr dry-run owner/name head base title...` - validate PR parameters without creation
`/agents github pr status owner/name number` - show PR status/reviews/comments
`/agents github webhook ensure owner/name` - register repo webhook
`/agents token check` - show safe token and storage status
`/agents openai auth|status|list|cleanup` - authorize a Codex/OpenAI account via device code
`/agents profile list` - show seed agent profiles
`/agents locale get|set en|ru` - show or change bot response locale
`/agents runtime smoke|status|cleanup` - create and inspect a Kubernetes smoke runner
`/agents dev smoke|status|cleanup` - run a Codex developer agent smoke task
